blurb: SharePlay uses FaceTime's end-to-end encrypted infrastructure to protect the data exchanged during a shared activity, so Apple and other parties outside the activity cannot decrypt it. SharePlay signaling uses the push channel established for FaceTime and activity traffic uses its encrypted data channel. When call membership changes, the key material protecting the activity is re-established: new participants cannot decrypt earlier traffic and removed participants cannot decrypt later traffic. Each activity derives its own key and participant identifiers, isolating apps and reducing cross-activity correlation.
